$comment: Single source of truth for the Message Scroller API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: The scrolling chat list. It stays on the newest message while you're at the bottom, stops following when you scroll up to read, and shows a "Jump to latest" button when there's more below.
thumb:
Any tips for Lisbon?

Bring good shoes.

Jump to latest

outline.description: Draw a frame: surface, border and rounded corners.

threshold.description: How close to the bottom, in pixels, still counts as "at the bottom".

height.description: Give the scroller a height (or put it in a flex column); the viewport scrolls inside it.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A conversation of bubbles that opens at the newest message. Scroll up and the jump button appears. In HTML, add data-vin-message-scroller.

examples.title: With messages
examples.description: Messages and a typing bubble at the end. New messages keep it pinned while you're at the bottom.

a11y: The scrolling area is a log (role="log", aria-live="polite"): screen readers announce new messages as they arrive, without moving focus.
It is focusable (tabindex="0") and labelled, so keyboard users can scroll it with the arrow keys and Page Up / Page Down.
It never pulls you down while you're reading older messages; the jump button is a real button and moves focus back to the log.
With reduced motion the jump is instant instead of a smooth scroll. Set aria-busy="true" on a message while it streams so it is read once, when finished.
